disagreements:
AUTHOR SOURCE REALIGNMENT — 2026-11-05T13:39:46.189Z; exact target remains pinned Nintendo Switch Rinato (catalog/research/guide agree). No permission or need to retarget to PSP/PS Vita. This edit changes source lane priority, research notes, and reader-only instructions, NOT any of the 1,438 executable Japanese simpleJp actions, save markers, ending paths or route order.

PRIMARY SET A: https://ruri-ototgame.hatenablog.com/entry/2025/12/30/225051 is a complete directly inspected Switch Rinato all-seven-route/ending walkthrough; it is now the authoritative Japanese Set A. Every existing step already followed its Japanese source formerly in jpGuide2; the source fields are transposed to place the Rinato quotation in jpGuide1 and older Choro in jpGuide2. All prior jpGuide1 omissions are now the correct second-guide omission placeholder, never fabricated text. This fixes the former mismatch in which earlier PS Vita Ancora was called primary despite the player path being Rinato.

SECOND JAPANESE SOURCE: https://maistar.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-2697.html and its independently authored seven route pages (enumerated in sources) explicitly cover Switch Rinato / Vita Ancora. The initial source_search incorrectly marked the second-Japanese-guide lane as missing although maistar is a complete independently authored set. It is now recorded as FOUND. Maistar supports seven major route and ending paths but sometimes makes different earlier optional/CG choices, so we avoid claiming identical saved states or duplicating every line. The independent Vita Choro and pandaihuku guide texts remain honest alternative-path corroboration. Choro's verbatim old Japanese lines occupy jpGuide2 as an earlier-version comparison only; maistar does NOT automatically inherit those quotations.

ENGLISH SEARCH: source_search records direct targeted English walkthrough search. A Tumgik/Mayokira English guide says it mostly follows the Japanese Choro guide and is derivative; it cannot count as independent English Set E. English source absence does not block this Japanese-corroborated-primary tier. Search source list and rejection rationale are recorded.

A3 4/3 / dated side-scene conflicts: A's full Rinato route has 4/2 「何かあるの？」 once and then directly selects the Luca MAP at 4/3 in five affected routes. Independent maistar Switch/Vita routes and pandaihuku Vita accounts show the same direct 4/3 MAP sequence, although their earlier optional choices may differ. The preceding full action run now uses a single exact-target Rinato Set A rather than mixing earlier Ancora questions into the player path. Parche 4/7 and Liberta 4/12 likewise follow A's full documented Rinato progression. Nova 5/22-5/23 text already matches A; older Choro's different dates/options are comparison-only. We are not claiming no possible alternative prompt can occur in every hidden state; the guide follows the complete reproducible A documented path.

DANTE NORMAL ED: Set A's saved-state chain is explicitly the Rinato page's own SAVE2 created on 5/31, matched to our local Save14. After the preceding ED2, load Save14, skip scenario to 6/1, duel XXXYAX and take tenth card for Normal ED. Independently authored maistar prints the extra 「何も失いたくない。でも、パーパも失えない」 after the duel from a *different* Switch Save1 after 5/26 and other-character 5/27–5/31 MAPs. Earlier Ancora Choro also prints the line, but neither is evidence that it must occur after this Rinato Set A SAVE2. The note previously offering it conditionally promoted an alternative guide state into the selected path; it has been replaced with the full source-A-specific Save2 steps. The current player-facing route contains no invented mandatory post-duel step.

REVIEW TIER: corroborated_primary, conservative because the second independent Switch guide does not print identical optional choice histories/flags even though it corroborates material route/ending structures. This is the normal automated tier of merged policy; explicitly note the availability of 2 independently authored Japanese full guides, and the attempted English search (derivative, not independent). Main steps and exact target are corroborated on the source-supported paths; no cross-version equivalence is asserted. No videos, translated/reposted sources as independent evidence, nor user gameplay requirements.

REVIEW GATES: changing jpGuide1/jpGuide2 attribution and reader guidance invalidates all prior accuracy PASS/CHANGES REQUESTED content bindings; structural reviewer should recheck route steps/ending/load behavior against new content hashes, but underlying simpleJp save/load actions did not change. Reviewer should examine whether the fully consistent Rinato Set A source path is executable, as well as the independent maistar outcome/optional-branch comparisons. All guide reviewed flags remain false until distinct accuracy and structural PASS; no author self-approval.
